import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 1000
k = rng.integers(0, 3, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 10, (3, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['group'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: compute screen coordinates of several anchor points for dragging
steps.eval: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const sc = a.renderer.projectWorld(a.anchorXY[0], a.anchorXY[1]); window.__brushX0 = Math.round(r.left + (sc ? sc[0] : r.width * 0.4)); window.__brushY0 = Math.round(r.top + (sc ? sc[1] : r.height * 0.4));

steps.name: drag brush over anchor points to paint them
steps.drag: (() => { const x0 = window.__brushX0; const y0 = window.__brushY0; return [[x0, y0], [x0+8, y0+4], [x0+16, y0+8], [x0+24, y0+4], [x0+32, y0]]; })()

steps.name: brush overlay has non-background pixels
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let nBright = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] + d[i+1] + d[i+2] > 100) nBright++; window.__paintedPixels = nBright

steps.name: [ key decreases brush size (brush tool is active)
steps.eval: const before = a.brush.sizePx; a.adjustBrushSize(-5); window.__sizeAfterDecrease = a.brush.sizePx; window.__sizeBefore = before;

steps.name: erase via Alt+drag: set erasing and drag again
steps.drag: (() => { const x0 = window.__brushX0; const y0 = window.__brushY0; return [[x0+5, y0+2], [x0+20, y0+8], [x0+35, y0+5]]; })()

steps.name: paint several points then write to DataFrame
steps.eval: a.brush = { ...a.brush, erasing: false, currentClass: 0 }; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) a.applyBrushStroke(a.anchorXY[2*i], a.anchorXY[2*i+1]);
